text.p: These are some of the leading stories in the official Iraqi press on Monday. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.
QADISSIYA
- Iraq celebrates 50th founding anniversary of Baath party.
- Two U.S. scholars say America will eventually find itself isolated because of its anti-Iraq attitude.
- New ship loaded with wheat anchors at Umm Qasr.
- Iraq and Jordan discuss bilateral relations.
- Argentina to supply Egypt with a nuclear reactor.
- President Saddam Hussein receives congratulations from officials on the founding anniversary of the Baath party.
- U.S. administration blackmails China.
- National Assembly denounces U.S. meddling in Iraqi Kurd affairs.
(The above were also carried by AL-THAWRA and JUMHOURIYA)
- Several articles on the founding anniversary of the Baath party.
JUMHOURIYA
- Gulf experts urge Arab states to shed U.S. protection.
- Palestinians support attacks on Israeli targets as they lose confidence in peace talks.
- Editorial says the Baath party is now a movement with international calibre.
- Oil Projects Company to organise international symposium.
- Thirty Kurds killed in Turkey.
THAWRA
- Editorial says the Baath party is the hope of the Arab nation in future.
